action_items: Fix blockSnapshot refresh timing in LiquidSiteBuilder.jsx - the buildBlockSnapshot() function runs immediately when selectedPage changes, but the DOM hasn't updated yet because React navigation is asynchronous. Need to add a delay or use a callback/effect that waits for the page content to load before rebuilding the block snapshot.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: Live cards don't update when switching pages
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In LiquidSiteBuilder.jsx, the useEffect (lines 38-46) calls setBlockSnapshot(buildBlockSnapshot()) when selectedPage changes. However, buildBlockSnapshot() scans the current DOM for elements with data-testid containing block hints. When selectedPage changes, navigate(path) is called but the DOM hasn't updated yet because React navigation is asynchronous. So buildBlockSnapshot() captures the old page's DOM elements instead of the new page's elements.
reproduction_steps: 4. Note the live cards count on dashboard (2 كرت/بلوك)
5. Switch to /operations page using page selector
6. Note the live cards count changes to 120 كرت/بلوك
8. BUG: Live cards count still shows 120 كرت/بلوك and cards have operations testids
rca_of_the_issue.suggested_fix: Add a delay or use a MutationObserver/useLayoutEffect to wait for the page content to load before calling buildBlockSnapshot(). Alternatively, listen for a custom event that fires when the page content is ready, or use a setTimeout with a reasonable delay (e.g., 500-1000ms) after navigation.
